text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the application for two residential towers located at 10-30 Dawes Road. Staff are currently reviewing the application. It has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. Staff will proceed to schedule a community consultation meeting for the application with the Ward Councillor.

The Toronto and East York Community Council directed: 1. Staff to schedule a community consultation meeting for the application located at 10-30 Dawes Road together with the Ward Councillor. 2. Notice for the community consultation meeting be given to landowners and residents within 120 metres of the site, and to additional residents, institutions and owners to be determined in consultation with the Ward Councillor, with any additional mailing costs to be borne by the applicant.
